goal: Create a real 'Becoming Together' Dialog on ke3p as the one active dialog, archive the domain's other 16 real dialogs, and convert its 78 dialog-less drafts into real LibraryItem records tagged Archive -- so Realm's actual data matches the reference Document's premise, not just its rendering.
done_when: A real Dialog row is created on ke3p titled 'Becoming Together' -- fields follow the existing Dialog model conventions (title, domain_id, available_to, context, document_status defaulting to 'drafts'); document the choice of user_id (null for domain-scoped/cast-shared vs Chuck's own id) since existing real dialogs use both patterns inconsistently

LibraryItem gains a real category mechanism -- e.g. category: String[] @default([]) -- since none exists today (confirmed: LibraryItem has no category/tag field, only source_type: upload|url|github|gdrive). Prisma migration only, no data-shape changes beyond the new column

LibraryItemSourceType gains an honest value for drafts converted this way (the existing enum has no 'originated from an internal Draft' option) -- do not mislabel converted drafts as upload/url/github/gdrive

A dedicated, manually-invoked migration script exists (not auto-run on deploy, not run as part of committing this handoff) that: for each of ke3p's 78 kip_drafts rows with domain_id=ke3p and dialog_id IS NULL, creates one new LibraryItem with source_ref = keeper://draft/{draftId} (the existing pointer convention documented in AGENTS.md), display_label = the draft's title, description = the draft's summary, category including 'archive', and the new source_type value -- then sets that same draft's own status to 'archived'

The same script archives ke3p's other 16 real Dialog rows (is_archived = true) -- not deleted, reversible -- and also sets status = 'archived' on the small number of drafts (8 total) still attached to those dialogs via dialog_id, for the same reason: consistency with the orphaned-draft treatment

The script defaults to dry-run: printing exact counts and a sample of before/after mappings (dialog titles being archived, draft-to-LibraryItem mappings) without writing anything, and only performs the real writes behind an explicit --execute flag
No drafts or dialogs are permanently deleted anywhere in this handoff -- archive/convert only, everything reversible

Confirm (do not assume) that existing Nav/Realm filtering already produces a clean result once this data is in place: kip-dialogs.ts's list route already excludes is_archived dialogs by default, and KipApi.listDrafts already excludes status: ['promoted','archived'] drafts -- no new frontend filtering code should be needed; if verification shows otherwise, report back rather than add speculative filtering logic
pnpm run quick:api passes for every file this handoff touches

Two decisions confirmed directly with Chuck before scoping this: (1) create a new Dialog rather than rename an existing one, and archive (not delete) the other 16; (2) the 78 orphaned drafts convert into real LibraryItem rows tagged Archive, not just a status flag flip on the drafts alone -- Chuck's own framing was 'Archive them where Archive is a Library category... Archive them type in the Library Archive,' which requires a real schema addition since LibraryItem has no category field today. This is production data. The dry-run-before-execute gate in done_when is not decorative -- do not run the real migration unattended as part of shipping the code; the script existing and being committed is fine to do directly per this repo's git.commit:true convention, but the actual --execute invocation against ke3p's real data is a separate, deliberate step that should happen with Chuck's review of the dry-run output first.
